acceptance: Red test first: at stage enforce, an audit with a prose sentinel and no audit-verdict.json gets no verdict (the N12 pattern of llm-isolation.md).
At stage shadow the sentinel still decides and the missing file logs ISOLATION_I8_VIOLATION.
100% statement coverage on each changed function; zero code comments.
fix: Add the audit verdict to the I-8 flow decisions (FlowDecision Clear, Read, Resolve and ISOLATION_I8_VIOLATION), with the prose sentinel as the legacy rung.

intake_override.reason: Waits for its trigger (the i8 enforce flip or the first unrecoverable bad verdict); the audit verdict path is protected core work

source: operator decision 2026-11-03, docs/plans/architecture-decisions-2026-11.md AD2-0/AD3-4; successor of verdict-sentinel-as-tool-call
summary: Build only when a trigger fires: the isolation.i8.stage flip to enforce, or the first bad audit verdict that the pipeline cannot recover. The audit writes audit-verdict.json with its schema in phasecontract.FlowDecisions under isolation.i8.stage; the prose sentinel becomes the legacy fallback rung. Every family can write a file, so no tool or MCP is needed.
title: The audit verdict is a declared I-8 flow file, audit-verdict.json, when its trigger fires
